caption: The video captures a young man seated behind a drum kit bathed in teal and magenta light, already mid-performance. He wears a black shirt crossed by pale striped straps and a silver chain necklace, his gaze cast downward in concentration. In his right hand the stick cycles between a near-vertical position and an angled sweep toward the cymbal, dipping toward the snare on some strokes with motion blur. His left hand holds a second stick near the large foreground cymbal, oscillating in smaller vertical arcs. A chrome drum mount reflecting pink light stands blurred at the left, while shelving fills the background. The camera drifts slightly, so the cycling arms and subtle body sway dominate the visible change. The drumming continues uninterrupted as an ongoing process rather than a discrete action that starts or stops.
